title: Pure Rust
description: Full-stack AI inference written entirely in Rust. No C++ bindings, no Python runtime, no garbage collection pauses. Predictable performance from top to bottom.

title: Apple Silicon MLX
description: Native Metal acceleration on M1 through M4 chips via the MLX backend. 14 model crates optimized for unified memory architecture.

title: OpenAI-Compatible API
description: Drop-in replacement for OpenAI endpoints. Chat completions, audio transcription, text-to-speech, image generation, and OCR via REST and WebSocket.

title: Ascend NPU Support
description: Run inference on Huawei Ascend 910B and 310P NPUs with 6.6x speedup over Torch-NPU. Enterprise-grade AI on dedicated hardware.

title: Voice Cloning
description: Few-shot voice cloning with GPT-SoVITS. Clone any voice from a short audio sample. 9 preset speakers, 12 languages, and emotion control.

title: Image Generation
description: Generate images locally with FLUX.2-klein and Z-Image models. Text-to-image in roughly 5 seconds per image on Apple Silicon.

title: ASR (30+ Languages)
description: Automatic speech recognition with Paraformer and Whisper. 18x real-time speed on M3. Supports 30+ languages with word-level timestamps.

title: Dynamic Model Loading
description: Load and unload models on demand. Share GPU memory across models. No need to restart the server when switching between tasks.

title: On-Device Privacy
description: All inference runs locally. No data leaves your machine. No API keys required for local models. Complete control over your AI stack.
